Will is Associate Professor of Medicine at [The Warren Alpert Medical School of
Brown University](https://medical.brown.edu/) and Director of Research and
Innovation for Pulmonary, Critical Care and Sleep Medicine at [Brown University
Health](https://www.brownhealth.org/). He is an attending physician in pulmonary
and critical care medicine and an Associate Member of the
[Broad Institute](https://www.broadinstitute.org/). His research interests
include pulmonary hypertension, pulmonary fibrosis, cell metabolism, adaptation
to hypoxia, and network medicine.
